title: Lost in the Weeds
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Lost in the Weeds | Worldly Cares, Stewardship, Generosity, and Fruitfulness - Luke v8:14

Our hearts cannot bear lasting fruit when they are choked by the weeds of this world. In Luke v8:14, Jesus warns that the seed can be crowded out by cares and riches and pleasures of this life, leaving a life that never comes to full harvest. God calls us to examine what is growing in us and to remember that whatever we sow, we will also reap.

Worldly worry steals today’s joy, the love of money distorts eternal values, and the pursuit of stuff can quietly take mastery over us. Yet the Lord is faithful to help us cultivate a fruitful heart. As we stay near the Master Gardener, trust Him for today, and steward His gifts with humility and generosity, our lives can be cleared of choking weeds and shaped for His glory.
